<!--
  A menu item: an optional icon, the label and an optional trailing mark (a check for selected items). tabindex
  -1: the menu moves focus with the arrow keys.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

  export type DropdownItemProps = {
    selected?: boolean;
    class?: string;
    children?: Snippet;
    icon?: Snippet;
    right?: Snippet;
    onclick?: () => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import ButtonPlain from "../primitives/button-plain/button-plain.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let { selected = false, class: className, children, icon, right, onclick }: DropdownItemProps = $props();
</script>

<ButtonPlain
  type="button"
  role="menuitem"
  class={cn("group flex h-9 w-full items-center px-2 text-left text-foreground", className)}
  tabindex={-1}
  data-slot="dropdown-item"
  data-state={(selected ? "selected" : "default")}
  onclick={() => onclick?.()}
>
  <Inline
    class={"flex h-7 min-w-0 flex-1 items-center rounded p-1 group-hover:bg-muted group-focus-visible:bg-muted " +
      "group-data-[state=selected]:bg-muted"}
    data-slot="dropdown-item-content"
  >
    {#if icon}
      <Inline class="flex w-7 shrink-0 items-center pr-2" data-slot="dropdown-item-icon">
        {@render icon?.()}
      </Inline>
    {/if}
    <Inline class={cn("text-xs", "min-w-0 flex-1 truncate px-1 font-bold")} data-slot="dropdown-item-label">
      {@render children?.()}
    </Inline>
    {#if right}
      <Inline class="flex shrink-0 items-center pr-1" data-slot="dropdown-item-right">
        {@render right?.()}
      </Inline>
    {/if}
  </Inline>
</ButtonPlain>
